textureFill: Closest occupied atlas texel, independently per part, using the rasterized UV mask; lossless WebP. sourceSha256 hashes the final decoded RGB.
rebake: R36: stronger contact AO and recessed timber fibres, cuts and dents.

surfaceRepair.reconstructionScope: The band fit, bore clearance, end-grain projection and microscopic surface response are artistic reconstruction. Reference photographs guide visible shape only.

historicalReferences.note: Viewed the auction's original photographs 3, 4 and 5. They show the curved receiver front ring, longitudinal bolt raceway, timber inlet, safety and cocking assembly. The game's finish and dimensions are artistic reconstruction.

mechanismRepair.reconstructionScope: The protective cheeks, cocking body, rear disc, safety flag, bolt stem, knob and rear notch follow visible reference forms. Dimensions and satin finish are artistic reconstruction.

runtimeNormalPacking.source: OpenGL material normals reoriented into the exported tangent frame, independent of pigment.

runtimeLosslessPacking: Per-image WebP lossless; round-trip RGB equality checked.

exteriorFinish.deviationScope: Bidirectional maximum vertex-to-mesh distances against Dots and R2 in part-local metres. No museum geometry measurement is implied. surfaceRepair and mechanismRepair are historical baselines.
exteriorFinish.materialSampling: Blended scan patches in object space with aligned pigment, roughness, normal and band-limited recess depth. The worn-steel normal excludes the source sheet curvature.
